candidates.name: 小型物资箱
candidates.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a single transparent game inventory loot-container illustration.
Primary request: completely new ORIGINAL container design in the distinctive ART STYLE OF ARKNIGHTS (明日方舟), especially its in-game inventory item illustrations and Integrated Strategies collectible illustrations. Strong illustrative graphic design, NOT a realistic product rendering. Japanese tactical sci-fi game item art, 2D hand-painted angular color blocking. Bold simplified geometric silhouette; large confident flat-painted planes; just 2 or 3 hard-edged light/shadow groups, subtly broken painterly brush edges, selective dark line accents, highly controlled detail. Strong rich COLOR integrated into the actual main shell, not merely a tiny accent on an off-white case. Dark charcoal recessed structures, muted broad shadow shapes, crisp small light accents. Avoid a glossy 3D/CAD bevel on every edge, photoreal materials, smooth plastic shading, microscopic grooves, dirty texture overlays, generic tool-box catalog aesthetic.
One CLOSED reward container, centered, 3/4 isometric viewpoint from above with front and right side visible. Full object visible; leave at least 12% transparent padding on EVERY edge. Square canvas, genuine transparent alpha background. No pedestal, ground, backdrop, floating rarity badge, border, labels, letters, numbers, logos or watermark. Readable as a 140px inventory icon. No characters or loose rewards. Industrial-fantasy visual interest comes from silhouette, layering, deliberate asymmetric graphic panels and a single focal latch; do not use ornate medieval treasure-chest furniture. Shared family motif: dark inset triangular clasp and a short diagonal painted stripe on the lid; each tier must have a clearly different silhouette and color identity.
TIER ONE / COMMON. Compact squat chamfered supply crate with a slightly sloped closed lid, rounded-trapezoid silhouette, two broad sides and an asymmetric dark belt wrapping one corner. Main shell is beautifully colored dusty SAGE GREEN and pale green-grey, with bone-white diagonal paint stripe and deep olive/charcoal shadow. A simple dark triangular seal/clasp at the front, one folded cloth strap as one broad clean shape. Economical light construction, small and humble but visually charming, Arknights supply-package item illustration. Three large color planes, a few purposeful edges. Not a suitcase, no carrying handle, no office safe, no tiny rivets, no off-white plastic product photo.
